And no, your soggy paper straw isn’t fixing any of it.

While rivers vomit city waste straight into the sea by the hundreds of thousands of tons, you’re out here sipping sad lattes through limp cardboard like it’s saving the planet.

It’s not.

⚠️ WARNING: This post contains descriptions of a fatal mass casualty accident

At least six people were killed and over 20 others injured in the early hours of Friday after a bus plunged 30 feet down a deep ravine in Del Gallego, Camarines Sur, Philippines. The vehicle was traveling along the Rolando Andaya Highway with 27 passengers and two drivers on board when it careered off the right side of the road. Local police reported that the 48-year-old driver, identified only as "Jay," allegedly fell asleep at the wheel, causing him to lose control of the bus.

Emergency responders worked through the morning to rescue survivors and recover victims from the steep terrain. While several passengers have been treated and released, many remain hospitalized with severe head trauma, chest injuries, and lacerations. Authorities believe at least two of the deceased are still trapped beneath the wreckage as specialized equipment is moved into the area to lift the vehicle.

Both the main driver and the assistant driver are currently receiving treatment at Maria L. Eleazar General Hospital. Local transport authorities have launched a formal probe into the crash, stating they will implement stricter checks to ensure the "mental and physical readiness" of long-haul drivers. This tragedy follows a similar incident in the same region in 2023, where 17 lives were lost on a stretch of road notorious as the “Killer Curve.”

#CheewaKnowsItAll 

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝗲𝗰𝗿𝗲𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗕𝗲𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗱 𝗞𝗲𝗲𝗻 𝗦𝘂𝘃𝗶𝗷𝗮𝗸’𝘀 𝗡𝗮𝗺𝗲!
Ever wondered why Keen Suvijak Piyanopharoj (สุวิจักขณ์ ปิยะนพโรจน์) has such a unique nickname? It’s not just a cool-sounding English word; it’s actually a perfect translation of his Thai identity!

🔍 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗕𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗸𝗱𝗼𝘄𝗻:

» 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙏𝙝𝙖𝙞 𝙉𝙖𝙢𝙚: His formal name, Suvijak (สุวิจักขณ์), comes from the Pali-Sanskrit roots Su (Excellent) and Vijak (Insight/Discernment). It literally means "The one who is highly discerning" or "Possessing sharp wisdom."
» 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙉𝙞𝙘𝙠𝙣𝙖𝙢𝙚: His father chose the name "Keen" because, in English, it describes someone with a sharp mind, astute intellect, and quick understanding.

⋆ ˚｡⋆୨♡୧⋆ ˚｡⋆

✨ 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗠𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶-𝗧𝗮𝗹𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗣𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗿𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘀𝗲: It’s no wonder he lives up to such a powerful name! Keen has proven to be an incredibly intelligent and versatile force across every field he touches:

» 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝘼𝙧𝙩𝙞𝙨𝙩: Captivating audiences with his singing, dancing, and acting.
» 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙇𝙚𝙖𝙙𝙚𝙧: Showing natural leadership and command.
» 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙄𝙣𝙩𝙚𝙡𝙡𝙚𝙘𝙩𝙪𝙖𝙡: Excelling in the demanding world of Engineering.

Whether on stage or in the lab, Keen embodies the "sharpness" his name promises. He isn’t just talented, he’s a polymath who proves that a sharp mind knows no limits!

Additionally, his last name ปิยะนพโรจน์ (Piyanopharoj) roughly translates to "The beloved one who shines with new glory" or "The beloved and eternally radiant."

"𝘈 𝘯𝘢𝘮𝘦 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘪𝘴𝘯'𝘵 𝘫𝘶𝘴𝘵 𝘢 𝘭𝘢𝘣𝘦𝘭, 𝘣𝘶𝘵 𝘢 𝘣𝘭𝘶𝘦𝘱𝘳𝘪𝘯𝘵 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘢 𝘣𝘳𝘪𝘭𝘭𝘪𝘢𝘯𝘵 𝘭𝘪𝘧𝘦."
